description.value:
HeroVerse is a quiet place to pray in English with Scripture, at night and in the morning.

Each prayer is written for HeroVerse and read slowly, with King James Bible verses shown on screen, so you can pray along: gratitude at the end of the day, honest words for what was hard, and trust for tomorrow.

On this channel you will find:
- Night prayers to end your day with God and rest in His care
- Morning prayers to begin the day with Scripture
- Short stories of everyday faith

New prayers every week. Subscribe so you can pray with us again tonight.

"I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety." - Psalm 4:8 (KJV)

Disclosure: our narration uses a synthetic voice and our pictures are generated; every prayer is original and every verse is quoted from the public-domain KJV.
